claims.statement: For a SAML organization whose resources remain invisible after user App authorization, the source advises an active organization SAML session before reauthorization. The linked guide is local under ghec and explicitly Enterprise Cloud otherwise. This conditional troubleshooting does not prove access or authorize regranting App permissions.

An organization missing from an installation list may require an active SAML session if it uses SAML SSO. This is a possible cause, not proof of nonexistence, absent permissions or guaranteed successful installation; distinguish installation visibility from user authorization.
